prompts: The owner's gaming rig hitches every few seconds even though the average frame rate looks fine, and the 1% lows are poor. A one-minute frame capture, a sensor log, a dump of the rig's settings and the owner's notes are in {WS}. That rig is not this machine: everything about it is in these files, and nothing is to be applied to this host. Find what causes the hitches and which setting changes fix them within the owner's constraints. Record in {WS}/result.json: avg_fps, low_1pct_fps, cause and changes (a list of {setting, from, to}).
answers:
**Goal:** find what causes the hitches on arena-01 and which setting changes fix them within the owner's constraints.

**Action:** read NOTES.md, settings.json, sensors.csv; computed frame stats from presentmon.csv (8238 frames); correlated slow frames with sensor seconds; wrote and validated ./result.json.

**Result:**
- **avg_fps = 137.29** (1000 / mean 7.284 ms, per the owner's formula)
- **low_1pct_fps = 45.35** (1000 / p99 = 22.049 ms)
- **Cause:** the GPU's PCIe link drops into **ASPM L1 sleep every ~4 s** (sensors.csv: `gpu_pcie_link_state=L1` at t=2,6,10,14,18,22,26,30,34,38,42,46,50,54,58; settings have `pcie_aspm_rp1_gpu: L1`). Each wake adds ~15 ms: presentmon shows exactly 180 frames of 22–24 ms (vs 7.3 ms average) clustered on those L1 seconds — that tail is the entire 1% low. Secondary: a Defender real-time scan (MsMpEng.exe, t=43–45) spikes DPC latency to ~400 µs and disk to ~80%, a second hitch source.
- **Changes:**
  1. `pcie_aspm_rp1_gpu`: `L1` → `disabled` (fixes the periodic hitches; link speed/width stay Gen5 x4, so the AI-workload constraint is untouched)
  2. `defender_exclusions`: `[]` → `["Arena.exe"]` (stops the scan-time hitches)

**How I know it's right:** the 180 slow frames in presentmon line up 1:1 with the L1 seconds in the sensor log (e.g. worst frame 23.68 ms at t=14.45, where the link is L1 at t=14), and the histogram shows only two buckets (7 ms normal, 22–24 ms hitch) — a clean bimodal signature of a periodic power-state wake, not a GPU/CPU bottleneck (CPU ~35%, GPU ~2730 MHz steady, disk ~2%).

**Assumptions:** 1% low computed as linear-interpolated p99 of MsBetweenPresents per the owner's stated formula; "within constraints" means no BIOS OC (XMP/PBO/ratio untouched — I didn't change those) and GPU link stays Gen5 x4 (ASPM L1 disable doesn't alter negotiated speed/width).

No browser tabs, windows or apps were opened; nothing to close.

--- result.json ---
{
  "avg_fps": 137.29,
  "low_1pct_fps": 45.35,
  "cause": "The GPU's PCIe link drops into ASPM L1 sleep every ~4 seconds (sensors.csv: gpu_pcie_link_state=L1 at t=2,6,10,14,18,22,26,30,34,38,42,46,50,54,58 while pcie_aspm_rp1_gpu=L1). Each wake-up adds ~15 ms to the frame presented in that second: presentmon shows 180 frames of 22-24 ms (vs 7.3 ms average) clustered exactly on those L1 seconds, which is the whole 1% low. Secondary: a Defender real-time scan (MsMpEng.exe) at t=43-45 spikes DPC latency to ~400 us and disk to ~80%, adding a second hitch source.",
  "changes": [
    {
      "setting": "pcie_aspm_rp1_gpu",
      "from": "L1",
      "to": "disabled"
    },
    {
      "setting": "defender_exclusions",
      "from": "[]",
      "to": "[\"Arena.exe\"]"
    }
  ]
}

--- tmp/analyze.ps1 ---
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8
$inv = [CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture
$p = '<WORKSPACE>\capture\presentmon.csv'
$rows = Import-Csv $p
$times = [double[]]($rows | ForEach-Object { [double]::Parse($_.MsBetweenPresents, $inv) })
$avgMs = ($times | Measure-Object -Average).Average
$avgFps = 1000.0 / $avgMs
$s = [double[]]($times | Sort-Object)
$n = $s.Length
$idx = 0.99 * ($n - 1)
$lo = [math]::Floor($idx); $hi = [math]::Ceiling($idx); $frac = $idx - $lo
$p99 = $s[$lo] + ($s[$hi] - $s[$lo]) * $frac
$low1 = 1000.0 / $p99
Write-Output ("frames={0} avgMs={1} avgFps={2} p99Ms={3} low1={4}" -f $n, $avgMs.ToString('F3',$inv), $avgFps.ToString('F2',$inv), $p99.ToString('F3',$inv), $low1.ToString('F2',$inv))
$hitch = $rows | Where-Object { [double]::Parse($_.MsBetweenPresents, $inv) -gt 33 }
Write-Output ("hitchCount={0}" -f $hitch.Count)
$hitch | ForEach-Object { Write-Output (("{0} {1}" -f $_.TimeInSeconds, $_.MsBetweenPresents)) }

--- tmp/analyze2.ps1 ---
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8
$inv = [CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture
$p = '<WORKSPACE>\capture\presentmon.csv'
$rows = Import-Csv $p | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ t=[double]::Parse($_.TimeInSeconds,$inv); ms=[double]::Parse($_.MsBetweenPresents,$inv) } }
$worst = $rows | Sort-Object ms -Descending | Select-Object -First 30
$worst | ForEach-Object { Write-Output (("{0:F2} {1:F2}" -f $_.t, $_.ms)) }
Write-Output '--- histogram of ms buckets ---'
$groups = $rows | Group-Object { [math]::Floor($_.ms / 10) * 10 } | Sort-Object Name
$groups | ForEach-Object { Write-Output (("{0}-{1}ms: {2}" -f $_.Name, ([int]$_.Name + 10), $_.Count)) }
